## Source: amazon-inspector (7db6d4bfe675bbaa2043f2958993761070ab6e5a09572d884082465b51bdf437)
package.json declares a runtime dependency `libsignal` with the source `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node`. The reference has no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash, so `npm install` resolves whatever the referenced repository's default branch currently contains and executes any lifecycle scripts bundled with it on the installer's machine. The owner of wanzchil/libsignal-node can push new commits at any time, and future installs will fetch and run those bytes with no version pin and no verification — fully bypassing the npm registry's integrity model for this dependency. A separate static match in lib/Utils/generics.js around a `ping`/HTTP pattern is consistent with WhatsApp/Baileys-style network utilities and is not independently indicative of malice.
